description: This Java class 'PollingStateImpl' implements the 'PollingState' interface. It manages and tracks the state of polling operations including current state, last state, and flags for new query, last query, and fast polling. The class provides getter and setter methods for these fields and overrides the 'toString' method for a descriptive output of the current polling state.

classes.name: PollingStateImpl
classes.description: Implements polling state management with static fields for different state flags and values, providing methods to access and modify the polling state.

methods.name: PollingStateImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all polling state variables to default values.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current polling state as an integer.

methods.name: getLastState
methods.description: Returns the last polling state as an integer.

methods.name: isNewQuery
methods.description: Checks if the current query is new.

methods.name: isLastQuery
methods.description: Checks if the last query was performed.

methods.name: isFastPoll
methods.description: Checks if fast polling mode is enabled.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the current polling state.
